name: Hans-Peter Baumann
bio:
Hans-Peter's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with go-karts. He devoured technical manuals and spent countless hours tinkering with engines. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from ETH Zurich, he started his career in Formula Student, quickly gaining a reputation for his analytical skills and calm demeanor under pressure. He transitioned to professional racing, working his way up from junior engineer to race engineer, focusing on GT racing. Hans-Peter is known for his data-driven approach and his ability to translate complex data into actionable feedback for drivers. His pragmatic problem-solving makes him a valuable asset to any team.

At Manthey EMA, Hans-Peter is highly regarded for his ability to optimize car setups for varying track conditions. He excels at building strong relationships with drivers, fostering open communication and trust. Beyond the technical aspects, he understands the importance of team dynamics and strives to create a positive and collaborative environment. His commitment to continuous improvement makes him an essential part of the team's success.

physical.description: A tall man with a focused gaze and a slight build, Hans-Peter always carries himself with a quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Swiss chocolate in the garage during race weekends.
